messages:
lina: Quick experiment: reranker+embed throughput across EU/US/APAC. TL;DR: GPU wins for dim>=256 at batch>=32; CPU reasonable for dim=128 small batches. APAC PCIe hosts show a 15–25% p95 penalty vs US — looks like PCIe gen + kernel fallback contributing. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

deepak: Can you paste the exact config (model, quant, kernel selection, warm vs cold, how measured)?

lina: Config:
```text
model: rerank-lite-v2
quant: int8 (per-channel) and fp16 baseline
kernel: triton fused_attention where available (fallbacks to generic_attention_conv)
hw: us-gpu: a100-80gb; eu-gpu: a100-40gb; apac-gpu: a100-pcie
batch_sizes: [8,16,32,64]
dims: [128,256,512]
proxy: nginx+grpc proxying, 2 worker threads
measurement: steady-state qps with 60s warmup, 5m run
pinning: cpu threads pinned, numa affinity set
```

sam: Method Q — are these single-request latencies (one request = a batch of N) or interleaved? Any cold KV misses that could skew p99?

lina: Single request contains the batch (so p95 is per-request for that batch). KV cache WAS warm for all runs. We captured p50/p95/p99 + overall qps. Representative excerpt: 

US GPU (a100-80gb), dim256:
- batch 8: qps 540, p95 38ms, p99 74ms
- batch 32: qps 1900, p95 45ms, p99 120ms

EU GPU (a100-40gb), dim256:
- batch 8: qps 420, p95 46ms, p99 95ms
- batch 32: qps 1500, p95 58ms, p99 160ms

APAC GPU (a100-pcie), dim256:
- batch 8: qps 360, p95 55ms, p99 180ms
- batch 32: qps 1350, p95 70ms, p99 230ms

CPU (48 cores), dim128, batch8: qps 320, p95 72ms — decent as a fallback for low-dim workloads.

jonathan: From product POV: recommend Hosted (US/EU) use GPU for >=256 dims; provide CPU fallback in APAC until kernel/pcie tail is resolved. Also need delta on cost per qps to share with sales. :thinking_face:

deepak: APAC logs show kernel selector falling back to `generic_attention_conv` for int8 at times (likely workspace allocation failure). Snippet: 
```log
WARN kernel_select: fallback kernel generic_attention_conv for layer 9
ERR cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (alloc 1.2GB)
```
Suggest forcing fp16 kernel there or increasing workspace and re-running.

lina: I pushed a variant that forces fp16 kernels for APAC. Early numbers show p95 improvement ~18% at batch32. Artifacts + charts: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/bench/rerank-1728 and s3://bench-results/1728675309/

ops-bot: deploy-bench: bench-job 1728675310 finished. Artifacts uploaded to s3://bench-results/1728675309/; CI report: https://ci.redwood.io/jobs/1728675310

sam: Action items: re-run APAC with fp16 forced + batch=16 + seq=256, capture kernel allocation logs, and test direct grpc (bypass nginx) to measure proxy overhead. @lina can you attach eval quality diffs for fp16 vs int8?

lina: Attached eval: NDCG@10 delta <0.8% fp16 vs int8, no regressions >1.5%. Scheduling re-run now. :thumbsup:

jonathan: I'll draft a short note for ops/sales: recommend APAC customers either pin to US/EU for best perf or enable Dedicated capacity until we fix the kernel selector.

deepak: FYI proxy (nginx) adds ~3–6ms under high qps in APAC due to epoll backlog; for hot paths consider direct grpc between proxy and runtime.

sam: Good plan. Next steps: (1) run APAC fp16 batch16; (2) collect kernel allocation traces; (3) update Dedicated sizing table for seq/batch combos; (4) summarize cost per qps. I'll own scheduling.

lina: Thanks — will post final numbers in #eng-ml and open an RFC for kernel selector tweaks.
